card.name: Words right before the word role
card.fires_on: The word just before an expected 'role' or 'job', most clearly 'compensatory' in 'compensatory role' in renal prostaglandin text. It also fires on a few other words that lead into a function or duty.

modes.label: Compensatory before role
modes.description: The ending of 'compensatory' where the next word is 'role' in kidney-physiology wording.
modes.example: renal prostaglandins have a compens<<atory>> role in the maintenance of renal perfusion

modes.label: Duty or function lead-in
modes.description: A word that sets up a statement of responsibility, such as 'our' before 'job'.

card.writes: It pushes the model to output 'role' or 'roles' next, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say that something has a 'role' in a body process or duty.
